Braidful

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row _builder_version=”4.16″ global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_column type=”4_4″ _builder_version=”4.16″ global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.27.5″ text_text_color=”rgba(0,0,0,0.44)” text_font_size=”16px” text_line_height=”1.8em” header_2_font=”Rubik|700||on|||||” header_2_line_height=”1.2em” header_2_font_size_tablet=”” header_2_font_size_phone=”30px” header_2_font_size_last_edited=”on|desktop” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

We are excited to officially introduce Braidful, a new braiding brand from Unity Salon created for festivals, pop-up shops, resort events, private events, and special experiences where hair should feel like part of the moment.

Braidful has been in the works for years, even if the name is new. Tamekia has been braiding for a long time and has brought braid services to pop-up events, resort settings, and special occasions in different ways over the years. Now, we finally have the right brand to represent that part of the work.

You can visit the new site at Braidful.com.

Our First Major Event: Country Thunder Arizona

The first major event for Braidful was Country Thunder Arizona 2026, held April 9–12 in Florence, Arizona. Country Thunder brought together music, shopping, vendors, and festival energy, which made it a great place to introduce Braidful in a bigger way.

Unity Salon was included on the official Country Thunder Arizona retail vendor list, alongside other local and festival-focused businesses. You can see Unity Salon listed on the Country Thunder retail vendor page here: Country Thunder Arizona Retail Vendors.

Now that Country Thunder is complete, we are thankful for the opportunity to bring Braidful into that environment, meet new people, and learn even more about what works for event braiding. Festival braiding is different from everyday salon work. People are moving, dancing, camping, taking photos, and looking for something fun that fits the day.

That is exactly why Braidful exists.

You can also see some of the Country Thunder videos and early Braidful content on TikTok here: Braidful on TikTok (@bebraidful)

Why Braidful?

At Unity Salon, we believe hair is personal, creative, and connected to confidence. Braidful gives us a way to bring that same care into event spaces in a fun, flexible, and approachable way.

Braidful is designed for:

  • Festivals and concerts
  • Pop-up shops
  • Resort braiding
  • Private events
  • Community events
  • Brand activations
  • Kids’ events and family-friendly experiences

Whether someone wants a simple accent braid, festival-ready braids, feed-in extensions, feathers, or something fun for the day, Braidful gives us a dedicated brand for those experiences.

A Brand Built From Real Experience

This is not something we decided to do overnight. Tamekia has years of experience with braiding, salon services, education, and working with different hair textures. She has also spent years thinking about how braiding can fit into events in a way that is professional, fun, and manageable.

Braidful gives that idea a home.

It is still part of Unity Salon, but it now has its own identity, its own event focus, and its own place online where people can learn more.

Learn More About Braidful

We are excited to keep building Braidful and explore more events, resort opportunities, pop-ups, and special experiences.

To learn more, visit Braidful.com.

You can also contact Unity Salon if you are interested in adding braiding to an event, pop-up, resort experience, or community gathering.

title.rendered: Spring Hair Extensions at Norterra | Unity Salon Refresh

content.rendered:
In Phoenix, we have a “Reverse Groundhog Day”—we are all crossing our fingers for a few more weeks of winter before the heat hits. This window of perfect weather is the best time to refresh your look. Whether you are heading to The Shops at Norterra to see the Easter Bunny at Elevate Coffee or prepping for a desert wedding, your hair should be ready for the season.

Maybe you want volume for graduation photos or length for a spring gala. All of these are reasons to want to inquire about hair extensions. Suddenly there is a sudden “shift” in how you want to express yourself in your next adventure.

 

“Do I ask for a consultation?” “Do I just Google anything that doesn’t make sense?” “Or should I just watch YouTube for HOURS until I find the person who has the exact same hair type as mine?” All of these questions are what I hear my new clients ask, and the common denominator is that everyone wonders what is real and what is true as to what they can actually wear.

 

So to answer the question “Do I ask for a consultation?” — the answer is ABSOLUTELY!!! And what questions should I ask? Well, you should ask ANY question, even if it sounds silly in your head. That’s what professionals are here for. Hair extensions are a luxury service that deserves your stylist’s full time and attention.

Whatever you choose, make sure it makes you feel better coming out of the salon than you did going in.

Happy extensions!!!!!!

Schedule your free consultation today.

Why Book at Unity Salon in Norterra?

Located right on Happy Valley Road, Tamekia specializes in high-quality extensions that look natural under the Arizona sun. We focus on a direct, no bloat approach: giving you exactly what you need for your hair type.

Our Spring Focus:

  • Flawless Blending: Matching texture and color so your extensions are invisible in outdoor lighting.

  • Method Selection: Choosing between beaded rows, tape-ins, or fusions based on your specific lifestyle.

  • Desert Maintenance: Professional tips to keep your hair hydrated as the temperature starts to climb.

  • Event Ready: Ensuring you are photo-ready for Norterra events, Barry Goldwater High graduations, and spring weddings.

Thinking About Extensions? Read This First.

If you are new to the world of extensions, this guide from Glamour is a great resource to help you understand the luxury service:

👉 Everything I Wish I Knew Before Getting Hair Extensions – Glamour

Visit Us at Norterra

Ready for your “shift”? Book your consultation at Unity Salon today. Let’s get your hair ready for the best months of the year in North Phoenix!

title.rendered: Back to School Already? Let’s Get Haircut Ready

content.rendered:
Can you believe Deer Valley schools are heading back before August even starts? It’s the earliest we can remember. Classes are starting in July, which means it’s officially time for back to school haircuts in Norterra.

If your calendar still says summer, you’re not alone. But those first day of school photos will be here fast, and I want to make sure your kids feel fresh and confident when the bell rings.

I’ve been seeing local kids from O’Connor and Boulder Creek High School for back to school haircuts in Norterra for years, and I always love catching up, hearing about their summer and getting them ready with a fresh look for the new school year. Whether it’s a quick clean-up, a trim for your little one, or a whole new style, I’ve got you covered.

I’m located inside the Beauty District at Norterra, surrounded by other amazing professionals. Plus, have you seen the latest? Norterra just got the very first Harkins Backlot – check it out here. Our neighborhood just keeps getting better.

Appointments fill up quickly this time of year, so don’t wait.

📅 Book your back-to-school haircut
📸 Follow me on Instagram for style ideas and updates

Let’s start the year off strong, one haircut at a time.

content.rendered:
If you’re new to Norterra and searching for a trusted Norterra hair stylist, welcome! I’m so glad you’re here. And if you’ve been around a while, I’m sure you’ve noticed how fast our community is growing. New homes, new businesses, and families moving in—it’s all happening quickly, especially with the Loop 303 corridor bringing in major development and opportunity.

As exciting as that is, there’s one thing I want to gently remind you: hair professionals aren’t multiplying at the same speed. So it’s more important than ever to find someone who not only knows what they’re doing—but understands your hair.

I’ve been in the beauty industry for over 30 years, and I’m still passionate about helping people love their hair. I’m based inside the Beauty District at Norterra, surrounded by talented stylists, and I specialize in textured hair, color services, and natural styles. Most of all, I believe in education, honesty, and long-term hair care—not just trends.

Whether you’re new or just looking for a new Norterra hair stylist, I’d love to connect. I offer free consultations, and if I’m not the perfect match for you, I’m happy to recommend other stylists in the Beauty District who may be.

Let’s grow together—because beauty should be a part of every journey.

👉 Book your free consultation here
📸 Follow me on Instagram

—Tamekia

content.rendered:
Today I’m thinking, “How are we THREE months into the new year?” So, of course, as the new “quarter” of the year passes, it makes you think and ask yourself if you have checked the box of some of your goals for the year that you placed on your vision board.

This year, what are your hair goals? Do you want to take a break from hair extensions, take a break from the curling iron heat, or even decide not to color those “sparkles” and let your hair do what it naturally wants to do? Whatever the goals and visions you have for your hair this year, PLEASE consult with a professional while you are in a small transition.

These days, I have been SUPER into watching the videos where the amazing Jack Martin transforms these beautiful ladies from grown-out color to their natural grey. I highly recommend you follow him and watch the transformations. I’ve done a few clients, and it is a lot of work but so worth it.

What are your “hair goals” for the year? And what products are you using to help you transition slowly?

title.rendered: Summertime Brings Summer Hair

content.rendered:
Planning for the Summer?

For some clients it’s

  • Letting their blondes be a “lived in blonde” and not worrying about any maintenance.
  • Wearing hair extensions so there is less heat damage done to their hair.
  • Using braids so that you can avoid ALL heat used.
  • Not using heat on those perfect curls and learn to embrace them.

Whatever route you choose, just remember to continue with a conditioning mask, trims every 8-10 weeks, and using ONLY professional products. OHHHHH and most importantly, check in with your hairstylist with any questions or concerns.  

Happy Summer!!!!

What Is “Summer Hair” in 2025?

Summer hair is all about effortless styles, natural texture, and keeping your hair healthy while enjoying the heat. Whether you’re letting your color grow out, opting for braids, or simply giving your hair a break from hot tools, the goal is simple: look good and feel free.

This year, the top 2025 Summer Hair Trends highlight low-maintenance looks, rich tones, and easy protective styles. From curtain bangs to soft copper shades, the focus is on looks that work with your texture and schedule—not against them.

No matter what trend you choose to try, keeping your hair healthy should still be the priority. That means staying on top of regular trims, using a deep conditioner or mask weekly, and protecting your hair from sun and heat damage. If you’re unsure which style or routine is best for your hair type this season, reach out to us here — we’re happy to help you create a summer plan that fits your lifestyle and makes you feel amazing.

title.rendered: Hair Extensions in Norterra

content.rendered:
Hair Extensions Aren’t Just for Scottsdale Anymore

Years ago, hair extensions were a service that only the “elite” clients used. In Arizona, most of these clients lived in or visited Scottsdale. BUT times have changed! Supply and demand have made it easier for everyone to access hair extensions.

Although they are still considered a “luxury service,” more and more clients are trying — and loving — them. Businesswomen, athletes, and tons of stay-at-home moms all want and deserve to feel beautiful. Now, women from all over the Valley are inquiring and booking these services.

Clients Are Coming From All Over the Valley

At Unity Salon, located inside The Beauty District of Norterra, I’m seeing more consultations and bookings every week. It’s no longer just the Scottsdale clientele. Women from north Phoenix, Mesa, Chandler, and Gilbert are adding extensions to their hair services.

I’m also booking more free consultations so clients can ask questions. This gives me the chance to recommend the best options for their hair and lifestyle.

It’s Okay to Want a Boost of Confidence

Sometimes it’s hard to rationalize getting hair extensions. I get it. As women, mothers, or wives, we can easily talk ourselves out of doing things we would love — things that give us that little “boost” of confidence.

But why don’t we invest in ourselves?

So You Ask, “Tamekia, Seriously, How Can Hair Extensions Help???”

  • Makes your morning routine faster and easier — a bun is simple and quick

  • Adds length and/or fullness to your hair

  • Helps styles last longer

  • Can reduce or eliminate heat styling on your natural hair

  • Gives you that extra boost of confidence

  • Can add dimension and color

The Honest Truth: One Small Downside

With all the great benefits, I do want to be transparent about one thing. Sometimes, your stylist might recommend taking a break from extensions. Occasionally, clients are resistant to that idea.

It’s my advice to trust your stylist and be open to a hybrid approach. That way, you get the best results while keeping your hair healthy and your lifestyle in mind.

We’re looking forward to seeing you soon! While you’re at Unity Salon, make sure to take full advantage of all the other great shops at Norterra.

Schedule a Consultation

There are many methods for hair extensions, make sure to consult with your stylist to make sure they know what is best for you.

title.rendered: DevaCurl & Curly Hair Specialist

content.rendered:
Over three years ago, I got certified through DevaCurl as a curl specialist for haircuts. I can still remember my training like it was yesterday.

I went into the training thinking it would be a breeze because I had experience in the industry and was a licensed educator, but that was totally not the case. The class included other licensed hairstylists with many different backgrounds and experience levels. I went in thinking the class would be easy considering my background (from Florida with years of experience in textured hair), and that was a hard no! I really had to think about the angles, degrees, motions, and all the little details.

Needless to say, it was a humbling experience. Every single part of the DevaCurl training and curriculum was carefully thought out and perfected. Their technique for cutting, shampooing, and diffusing was awesome and worked so well for my curly, wavy, and extra-curly clients.

Still today, my clients love the service because of the education I provide, the time I take to understand their daily or weekly hair routine, and the effort I make to hear what they love about their curls. I don’t change what they love. I focus on what they’re willing to change and make sure they feel heard and fully understood.

With hair coloring being my number one requested service, DevaCurl haircuts come in as a strong number two. I love my textured hair clients because they all have a unique story to share about their “curly girl journey.”

Book your appointment today.

title.rendered: Add Unity To Our Community

content.rendered:
Recently, I had a conversation with three clients about the terms African American and Caucasian. The reason the term was brought up is because I love hearing what key terms my clients list in their Google search when looking for a salon. One client (of African American descent) takes no offense to the term. Another client (also of African American descent) says she takes offense to the term because we aren’t in Africa, so we should be addressed simply as American. Although both clients were not wrong in their stance, it does raise the question: “What term should we use, and what do others who address us use?”

As much as I want to live in my perfect little “bubble” and believe that everything is good and has good intentions behind it, unfortunately, that is very far from the truth. So, in conclusion, I would suggest that we have open conversations with our family and friends of common and uncommon races so that we can all become educated and bring “UNITY” to our commUNITY.

At Unity Salon, we believe true beauty begins with understanding.
If this conversation resonated with you, we invite you to join us in building a stronger, more inclusive community. Let’s keep the dialogue going and explore ways we can collaborate on topics like this and more.
👉 Contact us here to partner, share ideas, or create positive change—together.

title.rendered: Vacation Time – Still Thinking About Hair

content.rendered:
Finding Creativity on Vacation

I often tell my husband that I need a vacation so that I can be more “creative” about work, education, and of course, our family. As I sit near the beautiful beach in Puerto Vallarta, I realize that I STILL do some of the same habits I do in Phoenix — such as people-watching and examining others’ hairstyles.

Who is wearing extensions? How was their color technique performed? Did they get their hair done right before the vacation? During all my silly evaluations, my husband shows the least bit of interest (lol).

But one thing I know for sure: most people want to look and feel their best while on vacation. For some, it includes working out profusely before the trip or going on an extreme diet. Then there are those paying tons for hair services they wouldn’t normally do for their everyday lifestyle.

Are Hair Extensions for Vacation or a Lifestyle?

Which leads me to the questions:
Do clients want to invest in hair extensions for vacations, or are hair extensions a lifestyle choice?

My goal is to educate my clients on how and when to wear hair extensions — and what method is best for their lifestyle. Do we have to be going on vacation to look and feel fabulous? The answer to that question should be NO.

We should feel fabulous whether we’re on vacation, going to work, or staying at home with family. Feeling fabulous looks different for each individual. As hairstylists, it’s our job to educate clients on the best extension method for their needs.

Choosing the Best Hair Extension Method

The number one service in my salon is volume wefts and I-tips; however, I’m not opposed to other methods. For many clients, I suggest a “hybrid method” because the density in each section of a client’s hair is different.

Hair Extensions For Vacations: How to Keep Your Extensions Looking Fabulous After Your Trip

Maintaining your hair extensions for vacations — and long after you return — is key to keeping them beautiful and lasting as long as possible. For a full set of tips on caring for your extensions, check out this helpful hair extension care guide from Allure. This resource covers essential practices like proper washing techniques, detangling methods, heat protection, and nightly routines to help keep your hair extensions in top condition.

​At Unity Salon, we love helping you feel confident no matter the season. For more tips on keeping your hair healthy and vibrant during warmer months, check out our post on summertime hair care and summer styles.

title.rendered: Hair Extensions Provide Instant Transformation

content.rendered:
Oftentimes I receive requests for hair extensions consultations, and although I shouldn’t be biased I have to admit that they are some of my favorite appointments. Why would they be better than most appointment requests?

For me it’s the excitement and their anticipation. When the client enters the salon they have so many unknowns and so many positive yet negative emotions because in just a few hours a person can go from a “stepchild” who no one respects to a “Cinderella” that everyone sees when she enters the room. Does everyone want to be the “Cinderella”? Not everyone desires a huge transformation; and for those clients it’s an option to only add one row or even a few individual extensions.

In the 27 years I’ve been adding hair extensions to my clients I can proudly say that a client has never left crying because they were disappointed with their extension service (unfortunately in the beginning of my career I had a handful of clients leave unhappy with a haircut or color). I have seen some tears because they feel more like themselves or better than they expected.

So after many years of doing hair, I would have to say that hair extensions are my favorite because I get to help other women OR men bring their smiles and confidence back. Not to mention that our time together always teaches me something new, humbles me in some way, and reminds me what my purpose is.

Schedule your consultation at our salon in the Norterra Beauty District (North Phoenix) and begin your transformation.

title.rendered: People Watching

content.rendered:
One of the advantages of my cute little salon suite is that sometimes my clients like to “people watch” while I do their hair or while they are processing. But this particular Saturday in April I saw the SWEETEST and best reminder of why my logo and name could make a small difference in my community. There were three kids who seem to be all under the age of 6 years old who stopped in front of my suite to talk about the Unity Salon logo. Of course I couldn’t hear their conversation but I saw their cute little reactions and it made my heart so happy. They pointed back and forth at the two ladies on the logo as they appeared to be examining their hair. In my heart I was hoping that the conversation went something like this:

“Look at her pretty hair!”
“Yes and she has pretty hair TOO!”
“They are both so pretty and they are both together and happy.”

Unity Salon was formed during COVID-19, amidst the riots, and Black Lives Matters campaigns for the hair industry. It was sad to know that so many people are divided in the hair industry and are afraid to do hair that is totally different than their own. This doesn’t just mean a Caucasian stylist not doing Asian or African American hair texture; but it can also mean an African American stylist not doing Asian texture or Hispanic hair texture. And as a Cosmetology Educator in Scottsdale, AZ if I saw this pattern I would always intervene and encourage students to do services outside their “comfort zone”. There was and is never a push back from students so I’m assuming that the disconnect happens after Cosmetology School. Regardless of how and when the disconnect happens, it’s important to know that we can’t change the city, state, or country in one day BUT we can come together in UNITY to make sure that every client has the luxury of choosing their stylist based on their personality, professionalism, experience, and not based on their nationalities.

title.rendered: Curly and Beautiful Hair

content.rendered:
Today I had a client that was biracial (which often means that her hair texture was curly and beautiful), and she came to me after reaching out to many other stylists with no results. Her goal was to be a level 9-10 blonde with the tone being silver/beige. Some stylists did not agree with the color because her hair texture was too curly, while others would not color because it wasn’t a “natural” style to do. But after an extensive consultation with her and her commitment to maintenance with me monthly, our first service together went GREAT. We took her “brassy” roots to an ashier brown and then color corrected some of her “bands” to give her blonde a seamless blend. I’ll see her beautiful face and hair again in 4-5 weeks.

About Unity Salon

At Unity Salon, we believe that every hair journey deserves respect, care, and expertise—especially when it comes to textured and biracial hair. Our mission is to provide a welcoming space where beauty is inclusive, and hair health is prioritized over trends.

As a curly hair specialist trained in DevaCurl techniques, we understand the unique needs of all curl patterns and celebrate the versatility of textured hair. Whether you’re dreaming of a bold biracial blonde transformation or a subtle refresh, we’re committed to working with you to create styles that honor your hair’s natural beauty.

Looking for more resources or stylists who understand textured hair? Visit DevaCurl’s official stylist locator to explore professionals in your area.
